name: careerjet-mcp
description: Careerjet (jobs): me, search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_careerjet_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CAREERJET_API_KEY
platform_mcp_careerjet_api_key.description: Careerjet publisher API key (free publisher sign-up at https://www.careerjet.com/partners/api/); sent as the HTTP Basic user name with an empty password.

platform_mcp_careerjet_user_ip.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CAREERJET_USER_IP
platform_mcp_careerjet_user_ip.description: The end user's IP address, required by Careerjet as the user_ip query parameter on every call (403 'Missing param user_ip or user_agent' otherwise).

platform_mcp_careerjet_user_agent.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CAREERJET_USER_AGENT
platform_mcp_careerjet_user_agent.description: The end user's browser user agent, required by Careerjet as the user_agent query parameter on every call.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Verified with a one-result query (Careerjet has no account endpoint).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Publisher Search API v4: page 1-10, page_size ≤ 100. Results are Careerjet redirect URLs to the original posting and no job id is documented, so url doubles as id; salary is a free-text string left in raw. An ambiguous location yields a LOCATIONS response with no jobs. Every call carries the configured end user's user_ip and user_agent as the publisher terms require; locale_code, contract_type, work_hours and sort are not exposed. No published rate limit.
